description: This file defines a custom reference implementation of a quantized linear module for PyTorch, integrating with the FX Graph Mode Quantization workflow. It extends nn.Linear and ReferenceQuantizedModule, providing methods for forward computation, initialization with quantization parameters, and conversion from a floating-point linear module.

classes.name: Linear
classes.description: A reference quantized linear module compatible with FX Graph Mode Quantization, supporting quantization and dequantization of weights during forward passes.

methods.name: torch.Tensor forward(self, x: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Performs the linear transformation on input tensor `x` using quantized weights, handling the quantize-dequantize process before applying the functional linear operation.

methods.description: Creates a `Linear` instance from a floating-point `nn.Linear` module, initializing weights and biases and setting quantization parameters.
